purpose: Inspect participant variation and extremes within each cohort. Raw observations should lead; use summaries only as a supporting guide and retain the same group and measurement identities as task 03.
mechanism: colored observations plus fine open supporting summary
expected_benefit: The initial valid panel visibly prioritizes larger opaque colored participant dots, while fine open grey summaries are subordinate; all three cohort lanes are clearly associated with their labels.
observed_tradeoff: A few Kerr points touch the supporting upper-box edge. The wider-offset revision created 16 unresolved point pairs and the third attempt retained one spacing conflict; both were rejected. Original valid image retained with this minor contact explicitly accepted.
record_timing: Purpose, roles, actual burden and concrete geometry were planned in create-intent.json, initial spec.json and agent working notes before first rendering; this durable summary was consolidated after bounded image review.
